page_title: EVE 4-0 WOL | Everton v Wolves 04/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.

90+4' Jack Harrison (Everton) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
90+1' Harrison Armstrong (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Salisbury had an easy-decision to make.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Orel Mangala comes off the pitch to be replaced by Harrison Armstrong (Everton).
88' A pass lands at the feet of Jack Harrison (Everton) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
87' CHANCE! Jack Harrison (Everton) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
86' Everton are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is behind the touchline and Everton will take a throw-in.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thomas Doyle (Wolves) replaces Joao Gomes.
83' Sean Dyche decides to make a substitution. Abdoulaye Doucoure will be replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Everton).
83' That's the end of the game for Dominic Calvert-Lewin, who is replaced by Armando Broja (Everton).
81' Jack Harrison (Everton) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
77' The game is interrupted as Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is flagged offside.
77' Substitution. Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) replaces Matt Doherty.
77' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Santiago Bueno is replaced by Toti (Wolves).
77' It seemed like Ashley Young (Everton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
75' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Michael Salisbury to decide. The relieved Everton players can finally celebrate.
75' Wait! Referee Michael Salisbury has indicated he is going to review the Everton goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
74' Substitution. Jack Harrison (Everton) has come on for Dwight McNeil.
72' Craig Dawson (Wolves) scores an own goal!
72' Joao Gomes (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for an infringement.
70' Wolves are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
68' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) meets a cross inside the box, but Jordan Pickford wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
67' Matt Doherty (Wolves) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
65' Goal disallowed! Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) scores but Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
62' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.

61' The most active player in today's match is definitely Joao Gomes (Wolves). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
59' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
57' It's time for a substitution. Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) comes on in place of Goncalo Guedes.
57' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
57' Mario Lemina (Wolves) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
55' Jordan Pickford displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
53' Looks like Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
51' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
49' 3 - 0 It's an own goal! Craig Dawson (Wolves) beats his own goalkeeper.
49' Dwight McNeil (Everton) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
49' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. Everton get a corner.
48' Half-chance! Matt Doherty (Wolves) plays a pass into the box, but Jordan Pickford reacts well to snuff out the attack.
47' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the corner but it's cleared.
47' The corner from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is intercepted by the defence. Wolves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

46' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
45+4' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post.
45+2' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
45+1' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sends a long ball in, but Jordan Pickford comfortably gathers the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

44' James Tarkowski (Everton) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
44' Dwight McNeil (Everton) will deliver the corner kick.
43' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton), but the defence gets it clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.
43' Dwight McNeil (Everton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
41' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The linesman signals a throw-in for Wolves.

39' Everton slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
36' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Orel Mangala (Everton) was quite harsh and Michael Salisbury didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

33' 2 - 0 Orel Mangala (Everton) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes inside the left post. He makes it 2:0 with this magnificent strike.

32' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.

30' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Jordan Pickford anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

29' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a throw-in.
27' Everton showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
25' The game is interrupted now, James Tarkowski (Everton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

23' Fine attempt! Ashley Young (Everton) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
21' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton), but Jose Sa is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
20' The goal by Everton won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
19' The Everton players halt their celebrations as referee Michael Salisbury makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

17' The ball from the free kick finds its way to James Tarkowski (Everton) who finds himself some space and scores with a thunderous header into the bottom left corner. An incredible long-range header!
15' Matt Doherty (Wolves) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
13' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Wolves are taking a throw-in.
10' 1 - 0 Ashley Young (Everton) fires a daisy-cutter inside the right post from the free kick just outside the box. Football supporters are always happy to see such a fabulous goal.
9' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.

9' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Jordan Pickford, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.

6' Joao Gomes (Wolves) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and curls well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
6' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Matheus Cunha (Wolves).

5' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.

4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Wolves are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

2' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Everton will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Salisbury.
